Glossary / Liability
Glossary · Corporate finance

Liability देनदारी (Liability)

Something a person or company owes to others, such as loans, payables or taxes due.

हिंदी में: देनदारी (Liability)

व्यक्ति या कंपनी का दूसरों के प्रति बकाया, जैसे लोन, देय राशि या बकाया टैक्स।

How it is used in the lessons

Limited liability: as a shareholder you can lose the money you invested, but you are not responsible for the company's debts beyond that amount.

From Stock Market Foundations

If your estimated tax liability for the year exceeds ₹10,000 after TDS, you must pay advance tax in instalments.
